features: 【ERGONOMIC & ADJUSTABLE SEAT HEIGHT】 - Modern gaming chair comes with adjustable human-curved lumbar support backrest & flip-up armrest to ease pressure & pain on body. Additionally, SGS certified gas lift makes seat height adjustment possible for the convenient multitask.

【COMFY & STURDY SITTING】 - Lounge recliner with breathable mesh for optimum temperature, pads high density permeable sponge to relieve hip and back muscle tension and heat. Besides, it has 360°solid smooth-rolling wheels for stable easy movement and quick pace of work.

BIFMA & SGS CERTIFICATION】 - ALPHA HOME chairs pass the BIFMA & SGS certification. Tilt tension knob locks any angle between 90-140 degree. There are different modes available: 90°comfortable working, 105°relaxing reading, watching movie 120°, and rest 140°.

【SIZE & EASY ASSEMBLY】 - Oversized heavy duty chair measures: height:35.88"-39.37", backrest height:21.26", back width:19.29", seat depth:20.87", seat width:18.9", maximum weight 350 lbs. Easy installation is required. Items come with hardware and necessary tools. It can be done within 10-15 minutes.

【CUSTOMER GUARANTEE】 - We want all of our customers to feel ready to take on the day from the comfort of our chairs. free replacement for damage & defective items and missing parts.This chair comes with 90-days warranty, and a 100% satisfaction guarantee, but if you’re not satisfied, please contact ALPHA HOME customer service
description: Breathable & stain free mesh back for cool sitting and anti-bacteria, allows air and body heat to go through, providing optimal air flow to avoid sweat and humidity. It is designed for easy clean with a dry cloth and a vacuum.

Backrest and armrest can be adjusted to a preferable position to hold your spine and armrest, keeping you away from back pain and stiff shoulders. And body-curved support makes office chair more fit for your body and daily needs.
Office chair with double padded seat cushion have strong resilience to cradle your body better for health and it won’t deform easily after long time sitting, prolonging the life span.

Office chair with height & tension knob for different needs is that you can use the knob to customize your personal height and tilt angle to get best sitting feeling and experience, to relieve body from unsuitable chairs.
All of accessories of ALPHA HOME, including gas lift are certified by SGS & BIFMA quality test. Durability are one of our primary concerns, which makes chair safer.
Equipped with heavy-duty chromed metal base, meeting room chairs are more sturdy and its maximum capacity up to 350 pounds, which is available for different kinds of people.
Easy installation is required. Items come with hardware and necessary tools. Following the instruction, you can assembly it within 10-15 minutes.
